Download the application form from the official website: https://nabarangpur.dcourts.gov.in/.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Nabarangpur District Court recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Nabarangpur District Court recruitment is 21st September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Clerk-cum-Copyist posts?
faq.answer: There are 10 vacancies available for the Junior Clerk-cum-Copyist post in the Nabarangpur District Court recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum age requirement for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for all posts is 18 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applying?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to these posts is 42 years.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for Stenographer Grade-III?
faq.answer: For Stenographer Grade-III, candidates need to have passed +3 or equivalent, a Diploma in Computer Application, Odia up to M.E. standard, and a Shorthand & English Typewriting course with specific speed requirements.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Junior Typist?
faq.answer: The salary for Junior Typist is Rs. 19,900/- to Rs. 63,200/- in Level-4 of the pay matrix.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes preparation of career merit lists, a Written Test, a Computer Science Test (Practical), and a Viva-Voce Test.
